paperInfo.subject: Business Studies
paperInfo.copyrightNote: Original practice questions synthesized from syllabus structure and recurring examination themes; not verbatim copies of copyrighted past papers.
paperInfo.sourceBasis: ZIMSEC Business Studies 6025/1/2 syllabus/specimen and examination structure.

questions.questionText: Which statement best describes business objectives in an A-Level business context?

options.text: It concerns decisions and processes used to achieve business objectives efficiently
It applies only to large companies
It excludes external influences
It concerns accounting only

questions.explanation: The first option captures the broad business-management focus of the topic.

questions.questionText: A Zimbabwean enterprise is reviewing entrepreneurship. Which action is most appropriate?

options.text: Analyse relevant evidence before selecting a course of action
Ignore stakeholder interests
Use the same decision regardless of circumstances
Avoid measuring outcomes

questions.explanation: Business decisions should be evidence-based and evaluated against objectives.

questions.questionText: A business has a value of $10,150. A change of 15% is being considered. What is 15% of the amount?
Which factor is most likely to influence a decision concerning stakeholders?

options.text: Objectives, resources, market conditions and stakeholder effects
The alphabetic order of customers
Only the colour of the company logo
None of the above

questions.explanation: Business decisions are influenced by objectives, resources, environment and stakeholders.
